source: The charts below show the top 8 most common permutations for each celebrity in our test from 337,492 reader submissions.
claim: For each of the 15 celebrities, the eight most common reader spellings and their counts are ranked 1 to 8; a misspelling ranks first for galifianakis ('galifinakis', 6,521), macaulay ('macauley', 8,451), mcgwire ('mcguire', 7,395), mclachlan ('mclaughlin', 5,167) and morissette ('morrisette', 9,043), while the correct spelling ranks first for deschanel, johansson, kaepernick, labeouf, mcconaughey, minaj, palahniuk, picabo, poehler and shyamalan.
